snippet.title: Gunfire Reborn DLC | Echoes from Primal Grove | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi everyone! We're thrilled to announce that the new paid DLC "Echoes from Primal Grove" will launch on October 23 (UTC)! And we're in the final stretch of development —gear up for a new adventure with us!

✨This DLC features two new heroes: Yoyo and Cang Jue, as well as four new weapons: Drift Shard, Armillary Sash, Viper Sight and Jackpot. By the time when DLC is launched, there will be a discount for the base game and the DLCs. Please stay tuned!

You can click here to wishlist our new DLC:
🎯Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3920680/_/

Thank you all for your patience and support! See you on October 23!💖
#gunfirereborn  #fps  #gaming  #roguelite  #gamevideo #gametrailer #槍火重生
